description: Source code for VoiceWakeRuntime actor managing voice wake detection, speech recognition, and related audio handling in a macOS app.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRuntime
classes.description: Actor managing the voice wake detection lifecycle, speech recognition, audio input, and user interaction overlays.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates the runtime based on application state, starting or stopping recognition as needed.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition pipeline with provided configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the recognition pipeline and resets internal state.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures the speech recognizer with a specific locale.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Processes recognition results, managing trigger detection, overlay updates, and capture initiation.

methods.name: maybeLogRecognition
methods.description: Logs recognition activity for debugging and analysis.

methods.name: noteAudioTap
methods.description: Logs audio buffer RMS levels during recognition.

methods.name: noteRecognitionCallback
methods.description: Logs empty recognition callbacks for debugging.

methods.name: scheduleTriggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Schedules a check for trigger-only silence.

methods.name: schedulePreDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Schedules a silence detection check after pre-detection timeout.

methods.name: triggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Activates capture if only trigger detected and no speech follows within the window.

methods.name: isTriggerOnly
methods.description: Checks if the transcript contains only trigger phrase detection.

methods.name: preDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Handles fallback recognition after silence detection period.

methods.name: beginCapture
methods.description: Starts a capture session for user speech after trigger detection or fallback.

methods.name: monitorCapture
methods.description: Monitors the ongoing capture session for silence or hard stop conditions.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Ends a capture session, processes final transcript, updates UI overlays, and triggers forwarding or auto-send.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Updates noise floor estimation and UI visualization based on audio RMS level.

methods.name: restartRecognizer
methods.description: Restarts recognition pipeline with current configuration.

methods.name: restartRecognizerIfIdleAndOverlayHidden
methods.description: Restarts recognizer only if not capturing and overlay is hidden.

methods.name: scheduleRestartRecognizer
methods.description: Schedules a delayed restart of the recognizer.

methods.name: consumeScheduledRestart
methods.description: Clears scheduled restart task.

methods.name: applyPushToTalkCooldown
methods.description: Sets cooldown to prevent immediate retriggering.

methods.name: pauseForPushToTalk
methods.description: Pauses recognition to implement push-to-talk.

methods.name: updateHeardBeyondTrigger
methods.description: Marks that user has spoken beyond the trigger phrase.

methods.name: trimmedAfterTrigger
methods.description: Extracts transcript content after trigger phrase.

methods.name: commandAfterTrigger
methods.description: Gets command text after trigger point, considering trigger end time if provided.
